## About
Nobody plans on an accident. When it happens, Buckeye Body Shop is here to repair your vehicle and return it to showroom-new condition. We handle everything from small dents and scratches to major collision damage.
Our technicians are certified by I-CAR, ASE and ASA, and the shop is fully insured and licensed by Miami-Dade County and the State of Florida. We use quality finishes so your paint holds up.
You'll find us on SW 105th Place off Quail Roost Drive, close to the Florida Turnpike. Ariel, the owner, and the team will greet you, explain the work, and treat you with respect from drop-off to pick-up.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs for everything from fender benders to major collision damage.
- Frame straightening: Frame straightening to factory specifications.
- Bumper repairs: Fixing damaged bumpers.
- Painting and color matching: Painting with guaranteed color matching.
- Paintless dent removal: Taking out dents without repainting the panel.
- Detailing and car cleaning: Complete detailing and cleaning, inside and out.
- Estimates, towing and rental cars: Free estimates, plus help with towing and rental cars while your car is in the shop.
- Pick-up and delivery: We can pick up your vehicle and bring it back to you.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're off Quail Roost Dr. (SW 186 Street), between U.S.1 and the Florida Turnpike.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: Is the shop insured and licensed?
A: Yes. The shop is fully insured and licensed by Miami-Dade County and the State of Florida.
